pipeline: cross-entropy (softmax classification), a separately trained variant
applies_to: train.py --loss ce (full CNN+BiMamba2 and CNN-only encoders)
output_layer: an explicit classification head Linear(512, n_candidate_hosts) added on top of the encoder

loss.name: softmax cross-entropy (torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy)
loss.formula: mean over the batch of -log( exp(z_y) / sum_j exp(z_j) )
loss.host_embeddings: candidate host FCGRs are not consumed by the loss; only the phage label is used

inference.rule: argmax / softmax over the classification-head logits
inference.softmax: produced directly over the candidate-host axis

bn_recalibration: not performed; the training running statistics are used as-is

architecture.conv1: Conv2d(1, 64, k=7, s=2) -> 64 x 29; BatchNorm; ReLU
architecture.conv2: Conv2d(64, 128, k=7, s=2) -> 128 x 12; BatchNorm; ReLU
architecture.mamba2: single bidirectional block; d_state=128, d_conv=4, d_inner=256, 4 heads, chunk=64

training.checkpoint: best validation top-1 within fixed epoch budget
